subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38364 remain the umbrella for both structured reply metadata and no-output fallback semantics, or should it be split/closed in favor of the narrower active items?
rationale: Current main is only a partial UI quote implementation, while the remaining behavior crosses protocol, session/runtime context, and channel fallback delivery contracts that active items already cover separately.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked Work Lands
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface tracker, then close it only after the structured reply metadata and final fallback decisions are merged or explicitly rejected.

options.title: Split To Canonical Active Items
options.body: Close or narrow this issue after moving the reply-metadata half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and the no-output half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Reject Structured Metadata Scope
options.body: Close this issue as intentionally satisfied by Markdown quoting only if maintainers decide Control UI should not expose structured reply metadata to agent sessions.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked Work Lands
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface tracker, then close it only after the structured reply metadata and final fallback decisions are merged or explicitly rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans gateway protocol, Control UI, and agent runtime boundaries where recent adjacent history points to steipete as a likely routing owner.
